indexes.name: idx_channelbookmarks_type_targetid
indexes.definition: USING btree (type, targetid) WHERE (targetid IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_channels_discoverable_team
indexes.definition: USING btree (teamid) WHERE ((discoverable = true) AND (type = 'P'::channel_type) AND (deleteat = 0))

indexes.name: idx_propertyfields_linkedfieldid
indexes.definition: USING btree (linkedfieldid) WHERE ((linkedfieldid IS NOT NULL) AND (deleteat = 0))

indexes.name: idx_propertyfields_unique_legacy
indexes.definition: USING btree (groupid, targetid, name) WHERE ((deleteat = 0) AND ((objecttype)::text = ''::text))

indexes.name: idx_propertyfields_unique_typed
indexes.definition: USING btree (objecttype, groupid, targettype, targetid, name) WHERE ((deleteat = 0) AND ((objecttype)::text <> ''::text))

indexes.name: idx_translations_channel_updateat
indexes.definition: USING btree (channelid, objecttype, updateat DESC, dstlang)

constraints.name: recapchannels_recapid_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (recapid) REFERENCES recaps(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: fk_retentionpolicieschannels_retentionpolicies
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (policyid) REFERENCES retentionpolicies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: fk_retentionpoliciesteams_retentionpolicies
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (policyid) REFERENCES retentionpolicies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
